notes: Blue tee = the 2023 back deck (E 537067-537075, N 4811054-4811068, features/overrides/hole05.geojson). It postdates the 2018 LiDAR and is levelled to a synthetic deck. The 2023 rebuild also moved the other sets. QA round 2 redrew White (E 537070.0-537079.4, N 4811018.8-4811039.4), Red (cut back to E 537061-537068.5, N 4810982.8-4811003.3) and Gold (E 537043.3-537050.5, N 4810920.3-4810927.3) to the stone-bordered mown decks in the 2025 photo. The 2018 decks they replaced (OSM 918946254 / 918946255) are rough. Blue measures about 600 against the card's 605 at the back of the deck. Round 2 checked the aim point: no single aim point inside the fairway (8 m inset) gives more than 602 yd, and a line along the fairway centre gives 600.7 yd, so the residual is in the card, not the line of play. A documented tee gap of about 6 yd is appropriate. The unassigned 52 m2 pad at 537054, 4810983 (OSM 918946256) is a retired pre-2023 forward deck, unmown in 2025, and is burned to rough as well.
